notes.albums: Nine albums: retro (21), hoodies (5), windbreakers (3), full zip (2), half zip (3), vest and training sets (5), fan version (14), kids set (3), player version (12).
notes.multiPhotoGarments: p461 and p463 are the SAME FILE at dHash distance 0, sent twice inside the hoodie album; both are claimed by the live blue training hoodie. p501 is a collar close-up of the floral embroidered away shirt in p500.
notes.dedupe: dedupe-0905.py again found nothing; all seven matches were made by eye against a contact sheet of the 15 live Arsenal listings. Arsenal is the most heavily duplicated team so far - six of the fourteen fan-version photographs were already on the store.
notes.tierSplit: The live listings carry no tier in their titles and their photographs are the FAN cut, so the fan photograph was filed as listed and the matching player-album shirt created with Player Version in the title (2025/26 home, 2025/26 home long sleeve, 2025/26 away, 2024/25 home, 2026/27 away).
notes.seasonReading: Sponsor pins the era on the retros: JVC to 1999, Dreamcast 1999-2002, O2 2002-2006, Emirates 2006 onward; Nike 1994-2014, Puma 2014-2019, adidas 2019 onward. Inside the adidas Emirates years the training wear, goalkeeper and special-edition shirts cannot be dated from the garment, so those titles carry a colour and are marked seasonConfidence unknown.
